scope: Observable treatment only. Story-specific people, anatomy variants, setting, palette, lighting and mood follow the written visual bible and actual selected references.
historical_prompt_note: Generation prompts remain provenance, not a claim of exact compliance. VIS-22's historical request for line legs differs from the accepted image: clothed bodies and legs, black line arms and rounded black hands. Preserve the accepted hybrid when that exact example is selected.
